card.headline: Another word for how
card.sub: in what way · by what means · to what extent · the way · however

beats.role: answer on screen at 0:00 (H104) + open loop (closed in 'the way how' tip). Phrase said inside a context sentence so 'how' cannot be heard as another word (critic note on the 'and'/'end' hook).
beats.speech: Another word for how, as in: how did you do that? In what way, by what means, to what extent, the way, and however. Ten words in all. And stay for the two words that many learners put together by mistake.

card.headline: Plain:  This report describes how prices rose and how much families suffered.
card.sub: Report style:  This report describes the way prices rose and the extent to which families suffered.

beats.role: before/after beat (critic note on h104-and: show a real sentence rewritten)
beats.speech: Plain English: this report describes how prices rose, and how much families suffered. Report style: this report describes the way prices rose, and the extent to which families suffered. Both are correct. The second one just sounds more formal, like a real report.

card.headline: How are you?  ·  How old are you?
card.sub: Keep how here. Swap it when it asks about the way, the method or how much.

beats.role: swap warning (critic gap on h104-and: which words cannot sit in the slot)
beats.speech: But not every how can be swapped. How are you? How old are you? Keep how there. Swap it when it asks about the way, the method, or how much.

beats.label: how in questions
beats.chapter: Another word for how in questions
beats.speech: Part one. Five ways to ask how.

card.headline: What's the best way to
card.meaning: how do I / how can I (everyday, asks for advice)
card.example: What's the best way to get to the airport?

beats.speech: What's the best way to. Use it instead of how do I, when you ask for advice. What's the best way to get to the airport?

card.headline: What ... like?
card.meaning: how was / how is (everyday, asks for a description)

beats.speech: What, and then like. Use it instead of how was, when you want a description. What was the film like?

card.headline: In what way
card.meaning: how exactly, which part (neutral, a bit formal)
card.example: In what way is this phone better?

beats.speech: In what way. It asks how exactly, or which part. It's neutral, a little formal. In what way is this phone better?

card.headline: By what means
card.meaning: how, using what method or tool (formal)
card.example: By what means will the project be funded?

beats.speech: By what means. It asks about the method or the tool. It's formal, so keep it for writing. By what means will the project be funded?

card.headline: To what extent
card.meaning: how much, how far (formal, common in essay questions)
card.example: To what extent do you agree?

beats.speech: To what extent. It means how much, or how far. You see it in essay questions all the time. To what extent do you agree?

card.headline: How was the film like?  ✗
card.sub: What was the film like?  ✓   ·   How was the film?  ✓

beats.speech: Careful. Don't say: how was the film like? Say: what was the film like? Or just: how was the film?
Which word starts this question? Blank. Was the hotel like? What, or how? | What. What was the hotel like? Like goes with what.

card.headline: Which one fits?
card.question: ___ do you agree with this statement?
card.options: To what extent / What's the best way
card.answer: To what extent do you agree with this statement?

beats.speech: Blank. Do you agree with this statement? To what extent, or what's the best way? | To what extent. It means how much.

card.headline: Say it now
card.sentences:
What was the film like?
What's the best way to get there?
In what way is it better?

beats.speech: Now say it with me. Listen, then repeat. | What was the film like? | What's the best way to get there? | In what way is it better?

beats.label: how inside a sentence
beats.chapter: Another word for how in sentences
beats.speech: Part two. Five words for how inside a sentence.

card.headline: The way
card.example: I love the way you explain things.

beats.speech: The way. It means how something is done, and it works everywhere. I love the way you explain things.

card.headline: However
card.meaning: in any way, it doesn't matter how (neutral)

beats.speech: However. Here it means in any way you want. Not the however that means but. Dress however you like.

card.headline: The manner in which
card.meaning: the way (very formal, reports and essays)
card.example: The report criticises the manner in which the data was collected.

beats.speech: The manner in which. It means the way, but it's very formal, so keep it for reports and essays. The report criticises the manner in which the data was collected.

card.headline: The extent to which
card.example: Nobody knows the extent to which prices will rise.

beats.speech: The extent to which. It means how much. It's formal. Nobody knows the extent to which prices will rise.

card.headline: So
card.example: How kind of you! That's so kind of you!

beats.speech: So. When how starts an exclamation, everyday English often uses so. How kind of you! That's so kind of you!

card.headline: I love the way how you talk.  ✗
card.sub: I love the way you talk.  ✓   ·   I love how you talk.  ✓

beats.speech: And here are the two words from the start. Not: I love the way how you talk. Say: I love the way you talk. Or: I love how you talk. The way or how, never both.

card.headline: The manner in which with friends?
card.sub: With friends: the way  ·  In a report: the manner in which

beats.speech: Can you say the manner in which to a friend? Better not. With friends, say the way.

card.headline: Which one fits?
card.question: I don't like ___ he talks to people.
card.answer: I don't like the way he talks to people.
card.note: the way or how, never both

beats.speech: Which one fits? I don't like. Blank. He talks to people. The way, or the way how? | The way. Never the way and how together.

card.headline: Which one fits?
card.question: Paint the room ___ you want.
card.answer: Paint the room however you want.

beats.speech: Which one fits? Paint the room. Blank. You want. However, or the extent to which? | However. It means in any way you want.
